Guardian: Must be targeted before other minions.
Rush: Can attack the turn it's played.
Challenge: Chooses a minion to attack as soon as it's played
Rummage: Select a card of lesser value in your graveyard, then return it to your hand. It costs one less.
Pilot: Can click mechs to pilot. Add's X/X to the mech's stats.
Dual Strike: Attacks twice. The second hit automatically targets the same enemy.
Voidtouch: Any minion it deals damage to dies instantly.
Shielded: Reduces incoming combat damage by X.
Ambush: Cannot be targeted when played. Loses Ambush after it attacks.
Amplify: While in play, all damage dealt to enemy creatures is increased by X.
